free_tier.stated: Unlimited volume. Push Zone storage '$0.12/GB per month and charged on a daily basis' = **$120/TB/mo**. Tiered down to $0.04/GB above 1 TB/month of stored bytes.

egress.terms: Interconnect from the storage cluster to the edge is free ('Interconnect traffic from our storage cluster to our edge servers is free'), but edge delivery is billed at $0.04/GB (= $40/TB) above the first 500 GB/month, and the 500 GB is itself priced at $0.12/GB. Pull Zone storage has no extra cost — you supply the origin.

tooling: FTP(S) and rsync-over-SSH for uploads; pull/push zones over HTTP. Free 14-day trial, no card.
chaining: The free-interconnect-to-edge idea is right and the price is an order of magnitude wrong: $120/TB at rest versus $6 Telnyx. Only viable as a free 14-day trial. The genuinely useful configuration is a Pull Zone (free storage) pointed at one of the free origins above — then KeyCDN charges you $40/TB for delivery and nothing for storage.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none published. Trial is 14 days / 25 GB traffic. Log forwarding $1/day, image processing $0.40/1k ops.
reliability_note: European DCs, TLS included. 14-day/25 GB trial is one of the weaker on-ramps in the sector.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
